Bill.BriefDescription: Developing a state policy for cell phone use.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to developing a state policy for cell phone use;and adding a new section to chapter 43.41A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.41A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The chief information officer must develop a policy regardingthe state's cell phone use. In developing the policy, the chiefinformation officer must consider strategies that will save costsincluding, but not limited to, the following: (a) Expanding opportunities for agencies to use prepaid cellphones; (b) Requiring agencies to turn in all unused and little-used cellphones unless required for emergencies or for the safety of employeesor the public; (c) Providing stipends to employees who use personal cell phones;and (d) Contracting with a private optimization specialist that canhelp state agencies match actual cell phone use with cost-effectiveprice plans. p. 1 HB 2504 (2) The policy developed under this section must be reviewed andapproved by the technology services board created under RCW 43.41A.070.
